thread:
Maya: Heads-up — ZephyrAir shows ~78% drop in token usage over last 48h. Billing alert opened, renewal in ~6w. I heard they swapped procurement lead last week and the CTO asked for a vendor benchmark. Also hearing they ran a quick pilot with NimbusAI. :eyes:

Jorge: On it. Pulling recent API logs and plan usage by endpoint now. Any sign they hit quota or aggregated 4xx/5xx spikes?

Priya: I noticed a small burst of 401s and timeouts Tue 10:12 UTC on their embed route. Could be a creds rotation or deploy that touched the SDK wrapper. Will attach raw log excerpt.

Priya: ```
2026-03-20T10:12:04Z zephyrair prod embed v1 401 unauthorized token_missing
2026-03-20T10:12:08Z zephyrair prod embed v1 504 downstream_timeout model/generation
```

Maya: Good catch. @Liam (Zephyr CTO) — can you confirm if your team rotated API keys or toggled a proxy/egress rule last Tue?

Liam (Zephyr CTO): We did a cost-saving toggle on Tue night to pause non-prod calls; shouldn't have affected prod but possible script mis-targeted. Also, procurement asked NimbusAI for a latency/cost comparison — they're pushing a replacement if results look favorable.

Jorge: If key rotation caused retries + failures that could explain volume collapse. I'll correlate success rates with credentials events. Also will export per-route TPS and token counts for last 14 days.

Maya: For the renewal conversation — recommend we (1) offer a targeted perf benchmark (dedicated run against their workload), (2) fast enablement session with their engs on batching/KV cache, and (3) a short economics comparison showing per-token + infra savings after applying our Optimize recommendations.

Jorge: I can run the perf bench. Need a representative prompt set from Zephyr and expected concurrency. Liam, can you share a small sample workload (10–20 prompts) and preferred seq len? We'll run both baseline and quantized variants.

Liam (Zephyr CTO): I'll DM the sample prompts and expected 95th%ile seqlen ~1024. We can do a 30m window next Tue.

Priya: I'll prepare logs/diagnostics and test a quick controlled run to reproduce the 401/504. If it's our config, I'll open a ticket and patch the SDK wrapper by EOD.

AutomatedBillingBot: Billing alert: account=zephyrair threshold=75% decrease detected; alert_id=ALERT-8921.

Maya: Sales ask — @Jorge please coordinate with @Ava (AE) to propose a 2-week trial extension + dedicated bench (no charge) to show performance delta. Keep it timeboxed so procurement sees lift quickly.

Jorge: Will ping Ava and draft the offer. Proposed message: "we'll run a no-cost performance run with your workloads, plus a 2-week trial top-up to validate production economics — results in 48h." Approve?

Maya: Yes. Also include a short Enablement 1:1 (30m) with our SRE to walk their infra changes and caching tips.

Liam (Zephyr CTO): That would help. If you can show latency improvements + a cost projection vs Nimbus, procurement is more likely to pause switching.

Priya: Running SQL now to get counts — command I'm using:
`SELECT account, count(*) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens, min(ts) as from_ts, max(ts) as to_ts FROM usage_events WHERE account='zephyrair' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY account;`

Priya: Preliminary: calls down 78% last 48h, tokens down 81%, error rate jumped from 0.4% to 6.7% around Tue 10:10 UTC.

Maya: Ok — action items & owners:
- Jorge: perf bench + coordinate AE offer + schedule bench (owner: Jorge) (ETA: 48h)
- Priya: confirm root cause for 401/504, prepare diagnostic bundle (ETA: EOD)
- Maya: schedule enablement 30m, draft renewal note to exec sponsor (ETA: tomorrow morning)
- Ava (AE): include 2-week trial top-up in outreach and loop procurement (ETA: 24h)

Jorge: I'll create the bench ticket and calendar invite. @Liam, please accept when you see the slot.

Liam (Zephyr CTO): Accepted. Thanks team — we'll try not to flip any more infra switches until after the bench.

Maya: I'll follow up after Priya's diagnostics. If we confirm it's on our side, escalate to eng-runtime for hotfix. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Posting diag bundle in a minute. Also adding a short checklist for the 30m enablement: batching best-practices, KV cache priming, retry/backoff tuning, and token accounting tips.

Maya: Great. Let's reconvene on this thread after the bench results. :eyes:
